perk.tac_rogue.cat.vitality: Max HP +%s%% — Increases maximum health, improving survivability on deeper floors.

perk.tac_rogue.cat.armor: Armor +%s — Reduces incoming damage. Stacks with equipment armor.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.velocity: Move Speed +%s%% — Increases movement speed for faster repositioning.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.stamina: Stamina +%s%% — Extends maximum stamina for sprinting and dodging.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.damage: Attack Power +%s%% — Boosts all weapon damage output.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.gun_proficiency: Gun Proficiency +%s%% — Enhances overall firearm handling: accuracy, fire rate, and precision.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.reload_speed: Reload Speed +%s%% — Reduces reload time for all firearms.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.ammo_efficiency: Ammo Consumption -%s%% — Chance to not consume ammo on shot.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.scavenger: Drop Rate +%s%% — Enemies drop more items and resources.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.gold_rush: Gold Bonus +%s%% — Increases gold earned from kills and clears.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.vampire: On Kill: HP +%s — Restores health upon killing an enemy.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.explosive: Explosive Dmg +%s%% — Increases explosion damage and radius.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.resistance: Status Resist +%s%% — Reduces duration of negative effects.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.fortune: Crit Rate +%s%% — Increases critical hit chance for bonus damage.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.handling: Handling +%s%% — Improves weapon swap speed and ADS stability. Bonus damage when aiming.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.mag_size: Mag Size +%s%% — Increases magazine capacity for all firearms.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.bloodlust: Bloodlust — Kills grant +%s%% speed and minor healing.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.medic: Combat Medic — Healing items are +%s%% more effective.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.dodge: Dodge — %s%% chance to completely evade incoming damage.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.stealth_extend: Stealth — Enemy detection range reduced by %s%%.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.titanic: Titanic — Massive stat boost (%s%%) but cannot sprint.
perk.tac_rogue.cat.executioner: Executioner — +%s%% damage against enemies below 30%% HP.

chapter.tac_rogue.1.title: §6Chapter 1: The Discovery
chapter.tac_rogue.1.summary: A dimensional rift appeared in the underground facility. Unknown hostiles emerging.
chapter.tac_rogue.2.title: §6Chapter 2: First Contact
chapter.tac_rogue.2.summary: First large-scale engagement with rift entities. Gain combat experience.
chapter.tac_rogue.3.title: §6Chapter 3: Marksman Training
chapter.tac_rogue.3.summary: HQ directive: Improve headshot accuracy immediately.
chapter.tac_rogue.4.title: §6Chapter 4: Shadow Operations
chapter.tac_rogue.4.summary: Infiltration mission. Eliminate targets without being detected.
chapter.tac_rogue.5.title: §6Chapter 5: Fortress Breach
chapter.tac_rogue.5.summary: Massive hostiles detected deep in the rift. Neutralize the bosses.
chapter.tac_rogue.6.title: §6Chapter 6: Iron Shield
chapter.tac_rogue.6.summary: Clear a floor with zero damage taken. Prove your defensive mastery.
chapter.tac_rogue.7.title: §6Chapter 7: War Chest
chapter.tac_rogue.7.summary: Operations running low on funds. Secure the supply line.
chapter.tac_rogue.8.title: §6Chapter 8: Blitzkrieg
chapter.tac_rogue.8.summary: Secure the floor before enemy reinforcements arrive. Speed is everything.
chapter.tac_rogue.9.title: §6Chapter 9: Endurance
chapter.tac_rogue.10.title: §eChapter 10: Heart of the Rift
chapter.tac_rogue.10.summary: Reached the rift core. Powerful boss swarm awaits.
chapter.tac_rogue.11.title: §6Chapter 11: Weapons Research
chapter.tac_rogue.11.summary: Collecting combat data. Varied weapon usage required.
chapter.tac_rogue.12.title: §6Chapter 12: Path of the Sniper
chapter.tac_rogue.13.title: §6Chapter 13: The Assassin
chapter.tac_rogue.13.summary: High-difficulty stealth operations. Make no sound.
chapter.tac_rogue.14.title: §6Chapter 14: Annihilation
chapter.tac_rogue.14.summary: Mass hostile surge from the rift. Eliminate all targets.
chapter.tac_rogue.15.title: §cChapter 15: Abyssal Guardians
chapter.tac_rogue.15.summary: Deepest rift zone. Defeat the endless stream of bosses.
chapter.tac_rogue.16.title: §6Chapter 16: The Perfect Soldier
chapter.tac_rogue.16.summary: Consecutive no-damage clears. Surpass your limits.
chapter.tac_rogue.17.title: §6Chapter 17: Purification
chapter.tac_rogue.18.title: §6Chapter 18: Race Against Time
chapter.tac_rogue.18.summary: Complete all missions before the rift collapses.
chapter.tac_rogue.19.title: §cChapter 19: Final Advance
chapter.tac_rogue.19.summary: Assault into the other side of the rift. Deploy all forces.
chapter.tac_rogue.20.title: §4Chapter 20: The Final Rift
chapter.tac_rogue.20.summary: Close all rifts and save the world. The final battle.
